scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Pure-Point Spectrum for the Two-Dimensional Anderson Model at Every Positive Disorder” (preprints/Pure-Point-Spectrum-for-the-Two-Dimensional-Anderson-Model-at-Every-Positive-Disorder-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 261 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17487e3a2720b36f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed h > 0, almost surely Hv has pure-point spectral type, admits a complete orthonormal eigenbasis, and has spectrum σ(Hv) = [−4 − h, 4 + h]. Its eigenvalues are dense in this interval. The probability-one event in this statement is allowed to depend on h.
